title: Existential-universal characterization of the second level
statement: For every language $L$ of binary strings, $L$ belongs to the second existential level of the polynomial hierarchy if and only if there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $V$ in polynomial time such that, for every binary string $x$, membership $x\in L$ is equivalent to the existence of a binary string $u$ of length exactly $C(|x|+1)^c$ for which every binary string $v$ of that same length satisfies $\langle\langle x,u\rangle,v\rangle\in V$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of binary strings
